MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub android keystore init [options]

Create the release keystore (RSA 4096, valid 100 years). Refuses to overwrite.

Options:
  --alias <alias>  Key alias (default: "memoriahub")
  --dname <dn>     Certificate subject (X.500) (default: "CN=MemoriaHub,
                   O=MemoriaHub")
  -h, --help       display help for command
